headline: Executive order directs the federal government to be ready to quickly deliver medical treatments to people after a biological attack.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a federal ability to get medical countermeasures, such as medicines or vaccines, to people quickly after a biological attack. No summary was provided, so the specific agencies, methods, and timelines it sets out cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: People living in an area hit by a biological attack
who_it_affects.how: They would be the ones receiving medicines or other treatments delivered under the federal plan.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle health and emergency response
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to build and maintain the ability to deliver countermeasures quickly.
